newsitem.title: USA: Dawson Science Corp gets China license.
newsitem.headline: Dawson Science Corp gets China license.

text.p: Dawson Science Corp said Friday it has received an unlimited license to operate cargo trucks in Beijing.
A Chinese government study estimates that for every car put into service, the company will realize $10,000 net profit per year.
Dawson said it has 5,000 cars on order, 1,200 of which are scheduled to be delivered immediately and 3,800 are scheduled to be delivered by early fall of 1997.
These cars will represent the largest fleet of cars in China and a potential $50 million in earnings, it said.
